parsed.modern: Lombards, judging that a favorable opportunity now offered of making himself king of Italy by her means, important his design to her, and declared his intention to marry her, provided by some means or other, as defeated Helmchild. Edmund, highly pleased with the proposal, resolved to satisfy her ambition by getting rid of the person whom he had married in order to gratify her avarice. Accordingly, having prepared a strong poison, the next it will wins, and gave it to her husband as he came out of the bath, and called for drink, according to his custom. Helmchild had not half emptied the cup, when, by the sudden and strange operation which he felt in his bowels, he controlled what it was, and with his sword pointed at the queen's breast, compelled her to drink the rest. The poison had the same effect on both; for they died in a few hours. Longinus, on the death of the queen, laid aside all thoughts of making himself king of Italy, and sent the king's treasure to Constantinople, together with Albofinda, the daughter of Alboinus by Rosamund, whom he had brought alone with her.
